caseDescription: Analyst concludes breach solely because a repository snapshot lacks a notification receipt
scenarioFacts: Snapshot has no notification log.
The packet does not establish a reportable breach, awareness time, risk threshold, feasibility, or whether notice occurred outside the repository.
Repository completeness is not established.
claimUnderReview: The controller violated Article 33(1) because the repository contains no notification receipt.
